name: Create data deletion requests from Gmail to Jira and BigQuery

parameters.content:
## Create data deletion requests from Gmail to Jira and BigQuery

Use this workflow to turn incoming privacy deletion requests into tracked Jira work, a limited BigQuery audit row, and internal Slack notifications.

## Review before publishing

This workflow has been manually laid out so sticky note text stays visible and nodes do not cover instructions. Keep the notes in place when customizing the workflow.

## Requirements

Connect Gmail, Jira, BigQuery, and Slack credentials. Do not paste API keys, tokens, real customer emails, private URLs, or production IDs directly into nodes.

## How to set up

1. Update `Set workflow variables`.
2. Replace placeholder URLs and IDs with your own values.
3. Test with the manual trigger before activating the Gmail trigger.
4. Review all sensitive requests before sending customer-facing replies.

## Step 1: Capture privacy requests

Use the Gmail trigger in production.

Use the manual trigger to test the workflow with sample data before activating it.

## Step 2: Configure variables

Update this node first.

Keep project keys, dataset names, channels, and SLA settings in one place.

## Step 3: Normalize and classify

Clean the email body, detect the request type, and calculate the SLA due date.

Unclear requests are sent to manual review.

nodes.name: Step 4 - Create task and audit trail

parameters.content:
## Step 4: Create task and audit trail

Clear deletion requests create a Jira task and a limited BigQuery audit record.

Manual review requests follow the lower branch.

## Step 5: Notify and confirm

Notify the privacy team in Slack.

Create a Gmail draft for customer confirmation so a person can review it before sending.

## Security warning

Do not store full personal data in the audit table unless your privacy policy allows it.

Use n8n credentials for authentication. Never paste API keys, OAuth tokens, customer emails, private URLs, Slack channel IDs, or production IDs directly into this template.
